name: InvestigatorSitePaymentTracker
tagline: Pay clinical trial sites on time – from EDC-verified visits to paid payment runs.
description: Complete investigator site payment app for sponsors and CROs: visit-based earnings at the contract fee, holdback until close-out, site invoices for pass-through costs, dual approval, payment runs with remittance, disputes, holds, aging and site statements. One PCF control for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Contract fee schedule and mismatch checks
Payment runs with gross/holdback/net and remittance export
Aging by site and payment terms
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
